plan.notes: TERM-BY-TERM SEQUENCE: official SIU Carbondale curricular guide (major map) PDF, 'B.S. Technical Resource Management 2022-2023 Major Map for 2-Year Degree Completion Progra'. Two-column YEAR N – Semester M layout transcribed in catalog order. Minimum grades (e.g. 'C') shown in the guide are not transcribed as prereqs. 'X/Y' alternatives use the first-listed option as the plan code. Guide header identifies this as a degree-completion / transfer-student map; only the completion phase is sequenced.
